# Priyanshu Gupta

> Personal developer portfolio of Priyanshu Gupta, known as priyanshubuild. Focus: C++, data structures and algorithms, Linux systems, and modern web applications. Open to internships and collaboration.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio](https://priyanshugupta.com/): Introduction, skills, learning experience, GitHub activity, about, and contact.
- [Projects](https://priyanshugupta.com/projects): Current project and practice descriptions.
- [Project updates](https://priyanshugupta.com/projectspage): Development status and practice repositories.

## Public structured data

- [Public profile](https://priyanshugupta.com/profile.json): Identity, professional profiles, interests, and contact details.
- [GitHub activity](https://priyanshugupta.com/api/github-activity): Daily contribution calendar and public authored commit rankings. Each successful source is cached for 15 minutes. Private activity is excluded from repository counts. The calendar and repository ranking measure different things. Requests may return partial data or an unavailable status.
- [Agent resource catalog](https://priyanshugupta.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Public resources available for discovery.
- [Sitemap](https://priyanshugupta.com/sitemap.xml): Crawlable pages.
